Case reference: 2014001408.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1997, two fishermen failed to arrive at their destination on Rat Lake in Manitoba, prompting their family to report them missing to the police. A search of the lake was conducted immediately, and one of the men was found alive on an island. However, Anthony was never found.

Case reference: 2024017079.CaseDesc: Dean Mattinas was last seen on March 18, 2024, walking west along Highway 11 in Constance Lake First Nation, Ontario. Dean has a history of high-risk behavior and may have been feeling despondent. He is thought to have been hitchhiking west towards Thunder Bay, Ontario.

Backpack: Synthetic, Beige, Tan, With white writing
Hat: Blue, Baseball, Toronto Maple Leafs logo
Luggage: Black, Duffel bag, possible Under Armour brand

Case reference: 2006007699.CaseDesc: Kelvin Norris left his residence on November 27, 1984 at about 11:00 pm, he has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2016010572.CaseDesc: Richard Jones was last seen at his family’s residence in Brantford in late fall of 1975 and has not been seen since. He was also enrolled in the Graphic Design course at Sheridan College’s Oakville Campus in September of 1975.

Case reference: 2005000899.CaseDesc: On April 21, 2005, a Caucasian male, believed to be between the ages of 29 and 50, was found in a wooded area on the embankment of a small creek off Queen Street in Bobcaygeon, Ontario. There are indications that this person suffered from early age-related osteoarthritis. It is believed that this individual had likely been at this location since 1994 or earlier.

Case reference: 2014002315.CaseDesc: In 1983, Dennis Chubb relocated from God's Lake Narrows to Winnipeg, Manitoba. It is understood that he was residing in a boarding house on Furby Street in the city centre of Winnipeg. Dennis was last seen entering this residential building after being driven there by a family member. It has been reported that Dennis relocated from this lodging establishment to another property immediately prior to his disappearance. We are currently unaware of his whereabouts.

Case reference: 2014032019.CaseDesc: On March 21, 1963, the dismembered remains of an unidentified man were found in burlap sacks on the side of the road near Pavilion, British Columbia. He had an old injury to his spine, likely causing pain and stooped posture, and was believed to have died a few months to years before being found.

Case reference: 2022017854.CaseDesc: On April 24, 2022, Laura Huebner was last seen at the Victoria International airport in Sidney, British Columbia.  Sometime later that same day, she had travelled to Nanaimo. Laura has not been seen or heard from since.

Hair: Blonde, Long, Long sandy blonde hair

Case reference: 2014001943.CaseDesc: Kam Lee was last seen in the Bishop Grandin Highway and River Road area of Winnipeg, Manitoba. Kam's current whereabouts are unknown.

Case reference: 2020011116.CaseDesc: Glen Peddle had been hitchhiking through the United States between 1982 and 1985. In April 1985, Glen called his mother from New York to tell her that he was planning on returning home to Newfoundland in the spring, but never returned home.

Case reference: 2014005754.CaseDesc: Scott Green was last seen on February 18, 2012 in the Centennial inner-city neighbourhood of Winnipeg, Manitoba. He left his residence after he made a phone call that night and has not been seen or heard from since.  It is uncharacteristic of Scott not to be in contact with his family.

Case reference: 2014006556.CaseDesc: On the 23rd of July, 2006, Preston Waldner was swimming at Paradise Beach, South Saskatchewan River, when he and another fellow were attempting to swim across the river. The boys got part way across when they ran into trouble due to the very strong current of the river. The one fellow was pulled from the river and survived, however Preston was seen going under and he never resurfaced. A search was conducted but he has not been located.

Tattoo: Left Chest, Howling wolf with the initial "PWW" above the wolf

Case reference: 2014005202.CaseDesc: On November 10, 2008, Ani Ashekian last contacted her family. During the time of her disappearance, Ani, a world traveller, was vacationing in Hong Kong, China, with two friends. At some point during her trip, Ani checked out of her hotel room, and made two cash withdrawals from a ATM.

Case reference: 2013000085.CaseDesc: On April 17, 1994, Jose Fernandez was seen for the last time at his residence in the Villeray neighbourhood in Montreal, Quebec. Following a disagreement, Jose left home in his car, a red 4-door Mercury Capri, without saying where he was going.

Case reference: 2008007999.CaseDesc: On September 19, 1980, Charles Leslie Lewis and a friend were out fishing on Gullrock Lake approximately 10km south of Red Lake in the Kenora District in Ontario. While they were out on the lake the winds picked up and began to create large waves, which caused the boat to capsize. Charles and his friend clung to the bottom of the boat but were pushed off several times by the waves. Charles was washed away from the boat. As he attempted to swim back to the boat, his head kept going under water.  At one point he did not resurface.

Jacket: Canvas, Brown, Orange, Hunting - ONG shoulder patches

Case reference: 2014002222.CaseDesc: On September 9, 1958, at approximately 9:15 a.m., Cindy-Lou McLane was last seen playing outside of her residence in Willow River, British Columbia. There is a strong possibility that Cindy-Lou may have been abducted.

Case reference: 2006027099.CaseDesc: Robert Deorksen and two acquaintances were travelling on Kioshkokwi Lake, Pentland Township, Kiosk, Ontario, in May, 1977 in a canoe when it capsized. His two acquaintances were located deceased, but Robert has never been found and is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2009004699.CaseDesc: On September 14, 1994, Kenneth Blais, 27 years of age, had an argument with his mother. He left his residence on Levesque Street, Sturgeon Falls, Ontario, saying he was going to meet up with his father. The family assumed that Kenneth went to the Ottawa region. Kenneth never met up with his father and is still missing.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Cross done by hand

Case reference: 2014001898.CaseDesc: According to her husband, Isabell Brooks left her home near Highway 7 and Tenth Concession (now Reesor Road) in Markham, Ontario on foot on March 4, 1972. Isabell said she'd return in a week, but she was never seen again.

Mark: Head, Mole on top of head

Case reference: 2015013522.CaseDesc: Richard St. Peter was in the process of moving residences. He was last heard from around Saturday March 14, 2015. It is not known where he may have gone, but he had vacated his last apartment and did not officially move into his new home.

Hair: Brown, Grey, Short, Receding hairline, salt and pepper goatee

Case reference: 2016061381.CaseDesc: On April 25, 1970 a Caucasian male was found in the ravine just north of Beechwood Ave. The ravine was located 300 yards south of the Leaside Bridge and approximately 100 yards east of the Don River.

Other: Rifle - Winchester Model 94 30-30 calibre, with a black and white rifle case

Case reference: 2014022293.CaseDesc: On February 21, 1981, Emery Laboucane left his home to go to work. He called his wife from work, saying he was on his way home, but never returned. His vehicle was later found at Edmonton International Airport in Alberta. Over the course of the following month, Emery's credit cards were used in California, USA, and then usage ceased.

Case reference: 2008000499.CaseDesc: Kimberley Ann Amero was last seen at her residence in Saint John, New Brunswick on September 3, 1985. There has been no contact with family or friends since.

Case reference: 2014002517.CaseDesc: Hélène Laferrière was seen for the last time on November 4, 1976, in the Saint-Sacrement District in Quebec City, Quebec. Hélène has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2024055255.CaseDesc: In the fall of 1964, Eunice Bird was last seen getting into a yellow sports car in Prince Rupert, British Columbia.  Eunice has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2015061728.CaseDesc: On the morning of January 25, 1967, Alphonse Brochu left his residence to deliver documents to a government agency in Ottawa, Ontario. That same day, Alphonse's vehicle was located on the Champlain Bridge, which connects Ottawa to Gatineau, Quebec.

Boots: Black, Rubber on the toe area
Shoes: Black, Rubber on the toe area

Case reference: 2020007628.CaseDesc: On August 16, 1971, at approximately 8:30pm, Stephanie Rawlinson was last seen near 2801 Jane Street in Toronto, Ontario. Stephanie had left her home in a cab after getting into a disagreement.

Mark: Right Eye, Mole near right eye

Case reference: 2014004707.CaseDesc: On June 17, 1986, Paul Leduc was going to the family cottage at Lake Duhamel in the Saint Jovite, Mont Tremblant area in Quebec.  Paul's vehicle and personal belongings were found at the cottage while his canoe containing paddles and a life jacket was found adrift on the lake near the cottage.  Paul has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014006426.CaseDesc: Sara Coates was last seen on August 1, 2013 in the Stanley Park area in Calgary, Alberta.  Sara led a nomadic lifestyle, travelling with her dog and three cats throughout Alberta and British Columbia in her van. On October 22, 2013, her van was found in a secluded area of Mînî Thnî (Morley) First Nations settlement, Alberta. It appeared to have been there for some time. Police investigations into Sara's whereabouts are ongoing.

Scar: 2 small surgical scars on inner groin

Case reference: 2022059675.CaseDesc: Rebecca Fudge-Schnarr was last seen on November 24, 2022, at approximately 10:00 a.m., at her family's residence on Moffat Road in Iroquois Falls, Ontario.

Case reference: 1996003690.CaseDesc: On August 29, 1994, Angela Arseneault was reported missing by her common law spouse. She was last seen on August 19, 1994, they and another male went shopping. Later that day, Angela left to catch a bus home alone. When her common law spouse returned home, the lights were on in the apartment, a window was left open and Angela’s purse was in the kitchen. Angela has not been seen since.

Tattoo: Left Ankle, rose and stem (6 inches long)

Case reference: 2015049499.CaseDesc: Loretta Garrett's husband and friends reported her missing on July 19, 1961 from Moose Brook River in Northesk Parish, New Brunswick. They were on a fishing trip and shared a car and parked near the trailhead. The men hiked across a trail until they reached the water to fish, while the women remained in the car. Shortly after, Loretta complained about the heat and bugs and started down the same trail as the men, but she was never seen again.

Case reference: 2006004399.CaseDesc: On April 20, 1970, Eldie Martin Sylvester attended the docks at Cedar Point, Georgian Bay, Ontario to await the "scoot" to Christian Island.  Witnesses believe that he may have left on foot to walk home to Christian Island across the ice. He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014002896.CaseDesc: On October 25, 1981, at around 10:00 p.m., Madeleine Thibault was seen for the last time on Commerciale Road in Lévis, Québec. While leaving her house, Madeleine mentioned that she was going to her mother's for a visit.

Mark: Mouth, Beauty mark on the left side

Case reference: 2014003770.CaseDesc: Herbert Gross was last seen by his girlfriend at the A&W on Portage Place in Winnipeg, Manitoba at 8:30 pm on 3 May 1996. He was supposed to meet his girlfriend for lunch the next day, but didn't show up.  On May 7th, a man described as Caucasian, in his mid-20s, 5'10", 140-150 pounds, clean shaven with short brown hair, was seen moving items out of Mr. Gross's suite. This man was wearing a dark shirt, faded jeans and white trainers. Police believe Herbert may have been the victim of foul play.

Case reference: 2019012883.CaseDesc: Elizabeth Semach was last seen on June 24, 1962, between 9 and 10 a.m., leaving her Niagara Falls, Ontario home. Elizabeth hasn't been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2005004699.CaseDesc: On September 3, 1995, an unidentified woman was found in the Niagara River, near the Maid of the Mist Dock. She had adenomyosis, similar to endometriosis. She had peach/pink polish on finger and toe nails. She is estimated to have been in the water for a few days.

Teeth: Good condition with a few white fillings. Both lower first molars were extracted before death.
Jeans: Denim, Blue, Levi's Strauss, size 27 waist and 22 inseam
Jewelry: Gold, Gold, wearing a 14" chain with crucifix; European 9K gold; manufacturing mark of "ATS"
Scar: Abdomen, 12 cm surgical scar below the naval

Case reference: 2014040055.CaseDesc: Clinton Lemay was last observed on Friday October 31, 2014, leaving his friends residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time Clinton was feeling despondent.

Shirt: Blue, Black, Plaid, long sleeved button up
Scar: Left Hand, 2" on the back of the hand
Right Hand, Small, on the back of the hand.
Tattoo: Left Forearm, Text " Clint Loves AR, Audrey"

Case reference: 2013000110.CaseDesc: Robert Gorassi is a full time resident in Toronto and was on an outing at Kinark Outdoor Centre where he was last seen at 4:30 p.m on October 25, 2012.

Hair: Black, White, Short, Grizzled beard, moustache & sideburns

Case reference: 2022054292.CaseDesc: Steven Blanchette Rochefort was reported missing on October 26, 2022. The last footprint of life for Steven  was on July 11, 2022, in Calgary, Alberta.

Case reference: 2006026399.CaseDesc: Kathy Anne Lulloff was last seen wandering off into the woods off Seabrook Lake Road in the District of Algoma.

Case reference: 2014004497.CaseDesc: It is believed Vernon Resch may have travelled to British Columbia.  He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2019044701.CaseDesc: On August 5, 2019, at approximately 6:00 am, Bridget Dalbe was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014002762.CaseDesc: On March 3rd, 1982, Laurence Peterson and Randolph Johanson were reported missing by Mr. Johanson’s girlfriend. Mr. Johanson and Mr. Peterson were last seen on February 28th, 1982, leaving the Shelter Island Marina, on their boats. Mr. Johanson was reportedly using his 26 ft. long salvage tug boat to haul Mr. Peterson’s 43 ft. wooden halibut fishing vessel to Lund, BC. The men were reported missing when they did not arrive at their destination. Extensive searches were unsuccessful. It has been speculated that the two men disappeared to start a new life.

Teeth: Other, Wide space in between the front teeth
Scar: Chest, 1 inch scar on left breast

Case reference: 2022010303.CaseDesc: On January 6, 2022, Jeannine Ermineskin was seen for the last time in Edmonton, Alberta’s downtown area.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Eagle, female face and a rose
Right Hand, The word "LOVE" on knuckles

Case reference: 2012002099.CaseDesc: Kelly Coleman was last seen near Mac's Convenience on Mapleview Drive in Barrie, Ontario in August 2011.  Kelly suffers from health-related issues and has not had contact with her family or friends since January 3, 2012. They are concerned for her well-being and are requesting assistance from anyone who may have had any contact with her.

Case reference: 2020014650.CaseDesc: On December 2, 1919, at approximately 5:30pm, Ambrose Small was seen for the last time with his lawyer in his office at the Grand Opera House in Toronto, Ontario.

Coat: Other, Dark colour with velvet collar

Case reference: 2014001046.CaseDesc: On July 23, 1990, the body of this middle-aged man was found on Gore Avenue in Vancouver, British Columbia. He died of complications related to chronic alcohol dependence.

Hair: Blonde, Long dark blonde hair with greying beard
Jacket: Denim, Blue, Young Life Creator brand
Shoes: Grey, Nike Air brand, running shoes

Case reference: 2014002549.CaseDesc: Wladyslaw Klisko was last seen on September 11, 1983 in Montreal, Quebec. Wladyslaw left his house in the morning and boarded a bus to go to church but he was never seen at the church.

Case reference: 2014034912.CaseDesc: Norman Playter was last seen on May 4, 2014 in the hamlet of Grasswoods Park, south of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan.  An investigation was conducted into his disappearance, which resulted in one person being charged. Although the investigation revealed who was responsible for his death, Norman's remains have not been located.

Case reference: 2013000043.CaseDesc: On September 4, 2010, Jonathan Jette and Rachael Bagnall went hiking in a mountainous region north of Pemberton, B.C. They intended to spend 2 to 3 days climbing some peaks in the area. They failed to return and were reported missing. Their vehicle was located however despite an extensive search, no other trace of them has been found.

Luggage: Light Green, Purple, Lavender, Mauve, 4 person tent
Sweater: Wool, Brown, White, zip up sweater (Hudson's Bay type)

Case reference: 2014001381.CaseDesc: On March 24, 1982, Patricia Elizabeth Flynn was last seen running away from her family residence in a densely wooded area near her home in Yarrow, British-Colombia. Patricia was despondent and had medical issues that required attention at the time of her disappearance.

Case reference: 2008023399.CaseDesc: Christine Ziomkiewicz was last seen on June 23, 1978, by colleagues at Queen's University in Kingston, Ontario, where she was employed as a laboratory technician. Her vehicle was still in the building's parking lot and there was no indication that she had left the premises intentionally for any period of time. It is not thought that Christine was in a relationship at the time of her disappearance.

Case reference: 2020009588.CaseDesc: On February 8, 1989, at approximately 7:30am, Soekarmia Sarbirja was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Soekarmia was to attend an immigration hearing on February 10, but did not show up.

Case reference: 2014005826.CaseDesc: On June 4, 2012, the Banff RCMP were contacted by a tour company to report that Duc Dao and his son, Nguyen Dao of Vietnam did not arrive to board their bus at the scheduled time.  The two men had been staying at the Banff International Hotel and there were no personal items left in their room. The two men were due to fly back to Vietnam two days later. However, they did not board their scheduled flight and it is unknown if they returned to Vietnam.

Case reference: 2014003286.CaseDesc: Kenneth Reed was boating with a friend on Lake Ontario, east of Sixteen Mile Creek in Oakville, Ontario, on August 26, 1982. Kenneth jumped from the boat and is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2014005899.CaseDesc: Karen Gilbert left her home in Quebec City, Quebec on October 7, 2012, at some point during the night. Karen was subsequently dropped off by taxi in the vicinity of Montmorency Falls in the La Côte-de-Beaupré municipality of Quebec City. Karen has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2024011368.CaseDesc: Guildo Maurice was last seen on March 8, 2024 in the village of St-Augustin, Quebec. The investigation shows that he left with his snowmobile. It was found under the ice between St-Augustin and Rivière-St-Paul, Quebec.

Case reference: 2023030253.CaseDesc: Autumn Shaganash was last seen on June 10, 2023.  She has had no activity on her bank account, no money on her person, and no cellphone. Autumn, according to her immediate family, suffers from depression and anxiety and must take prescribed medication on a daily basis. She hasn't taken her medication since.

Case reference: 2018029824.CaseDesc: Azizollah Nabizadeh was reported missing on April 30, 2018, by his mother, who resides in Sweden. Azizollah had informed her that he was residing in Toronto, Ontario when last they spoke 7 years prior. The last evidence police could find of Azizollah in Canada dates back to 1995.

Scar: Mouth, Small scar below the mouth

Case reference: 2015005930.CaseDesc: On January 31st, 2015 Ali Jamil was seen for the last time in the area of Prospect Point, Niagara Falls, New York, USA. At the time of his disappearance, Ali was despondent.

Case reference: 2014004904.CaseDesc: On the evening of April 5, 2007, Woon-Young Lee was seen for the last time at the West Park Health Centre in Toronto, Ontario.  When nurses came to Woon-Young's room the next day, she was gone.

Case reference: 2014003608.CaseDesc: Brianne Wolgram was last seen on the evening of September 5, 1998, in Revelstoke, British Columbia.  Ms. Wolgram had plans to socialize with friends that evening but did not attend.  Ms. Wolgram's vehicle was located on September 10, 1998 on the Alkolkolex Forest Service Road near Revelstoke.

Case reference: 2014004758.CaseDesc: Brent Bassett was last seen in December 1987 and was living on his boat that had no engine at West Bay Marina in Esquimalt, British Columbia. Mr. Bassett struggled with cognitive issues and was known to be friendly and trusting. Mr. Bassett  collected bottles from other people in the Marina for spending money and worked at the Salvation Army Thrift Store.

Case reference: 2014006038.CaseDesc: Kimberley Cruickshank was reported missing on March 25, 2013. She was last seen on March 22, 2013 in her apartment on the 2400 Block of Abbott Road in Regina, SK.

Hair: Brown, Red, Straight, Hair is shaved around sides and back with medium length section on the top
Pierce: Ears, 3 piercings on the right side and 1 on the left

Case reference: 2014004882.CaseDesc: On September 20, 2003, at approximately 10:00 am, Feng Lin was seen for the last time after he parked his car on Ossington Avenue in Toronto, Ontario.

Scar: Shoulders, Two on the upper left

Case reference: 2014005674.CaseDesc: Dannielle Loughran went missing some time on or after March 4, 2006, when she was last seen. Dannielle left the Aspen Grove area of Grovedale, Alberta in a white Chevrolet truck and was never seen or heard from again.

Case reference: 2014005313.CaseDesc: On September 24, 2007, Azelea Brown last spoke to her mother who was overseas.

Case reference: 2005001799.CaseDesc: On June 1, 1975, the body of an older adult female was located on the west bank of the Niagara River, in the town of Niagara-on-the-Lake. She is believed to be the same person who was witnessed jumping into the Horseshoe Falls on February 17, 1975. She is thought to be 40 plus years, short and heavy-set, with brown hair. She suffered from lung disease and had severe arthritis of her lumbar spine, which may have been painful. When witnessed going over the Falls, she was wearing a long overcoat, possibly grey, and carrying a green umbrella. There is no confirmation that the jumper and the deceased are the same person, however the general descriptions are in agreement. The condition of her remains suggest that she had been in the water for weeks to months.

Teeth: This female probably had a partial dental plate and still retained a gold crown on her right upper canine tooth.

Case reference: 2014005935.CaseDesc: On December 4, 2012, Lucien Bélanger left his residence near the Saint-François River in Drummondville, Quebec. Lucien was despondent at the time of the disappearance.

Case reference: 2006009599.CaseDesc: Elizabeth Ann Kant has been missing since October 16, 1972. She had been with a hunting party in Adair Township, approximately 73 miles east of Cochrane and was last seen about 2.4 miles south of Camp # 23, Abitibi limits.

Jacket: Black, Red, men's plaid hunting jacket
Jewelry: Gold, White, Yellow, ring; wedding band
Pants: Green, Ski slacks with elastic strap under the feet
Scar: Right Foot, from bone spur surgery

Case reference: 2012020078.CaseDesc: Anthony Whitehead was last seen on June 2, 1990, at a party on the Gordon First Nation in Saskatchewan. Despite searches and investigations over the years, Anthony has not been located.

Tattoo: Skull with top hat on one arm, unknown which arm
Middle Back, Skull and dragon, others
Left Hand, Phyllis Bluecloud covered to look like a bear

Case reference: 2006012599.CaseDesc: Ralph Grant was last seen in the Huntsville area between January 28 and February 22, 1999. He resided on Yearly Road, Huntsville.

Amputation: Lower jaw surgically removed due to cancer

Case reference: 2005002599.CaseDesc: On October 21, 1989, an unidentified man was discovered in the area of County Road 14 in Napanee, Ontario.  Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts that this man was of south Asian ancestry.

Shirt: White, Brand: Pierre Cardin; grey, blue, and red thin stripes

Case reference: 2014001111.CaseDesc: On February 7th, 1994, the remains of an adult male (25-50 years old), 5'10-6'0 tall, with a thin build, were located by land surveying students in a wooded area near the village of Anmore. The investigation determined the cause of death to be a self-inflicted gunshot wound. A black guitar case was found near the remains. He went missing sometime after May 1992.

Belt: Black, Blue, Fabric belt with a metal Indian Chief Belt buckle inscribed "HARA"
Jacket: Cotton, Blue, Blue with Green Gold piping sleeved Windbreaker Jacket
Pants: Nylon, Blue, Maroon, Sweat pants with zipper on cuffs
Shirt: Cotton, Grey, Black, Long Sleeved Sweatshirt

Case reference: 2006011699.CaseDesc: Justin Pollari is from St. Joseph Island, Ontario, and was last seen on Friday, December 7, 2001. He is known to be an avid skateboarder and may frequent areas where this sport is practised.

Hair: Blonde, Sometimes worn in a "Mohawk" style
Jewelry: Wood, Nametag with the inscription of "Woody"

Case reference: 2017040839.CaseDesc: Claude Lévesque was last seen on July 17, 2017, in the Mercier/Hochelaga-Maisonneuve sector of Montreal, Quebec. Claude had an appointment with his doctor that afternoon, but he never showed up. Claude was known to be despondent.

Scar: Right Forearm, Front of arm, wrist to elbow

Case reference: 2014003667.CaseDesc: On May 23, 1996, at approximately 7:30 p.m., Kevin Lotysz was seen for the last time as he left the McKellar Hospital in Thunder Bay, Ontario. Kevin is an avid drummer and enjoys music.

Mark: Cheek, Birthmark on lower right cheek
Tattoo: Chest, Sword on left side of chest

Case reference: 2006005399.CaseDesc: In October 1956, Charles Ombash and his brother Tom Ombash left the Pelican Falls Residential School near Sioux Lookout, Ontario. Their plan was to canoe back to Cat Lake, or to take the train to Savant Lake, hitchhike to Pickle Lake and then canoe on to Cat Lake. The family has not had any contact with them since that time.

Case reference: 2014004667.CaseDesc: On  November 25, 1999, the Gypsumville RCMP detachment received a report of an aircraft in distress over Lake Winnipeg near Reindeer Island, Manitoba. The aircraft, a single-engine Cherokee 140, was carrying three people; the pilot and two passengers. The pilot had declared that the engine had stalled and that he was trying to reach Reindeer Island. He then stated that he was going into the water. Two RCMP and an Air Search and Rescue Hercules aircrafts conducted an aerial search. It was not possible to search the lake by boat as there was too much ice on the lake. All three are presumed dead from drowning or the impact of the crash.

Case reference: 2022037048.CaseDesc: On June 20, 2008, the body of an unidentified man was recovered from Lake Erie, approximately one mile off the north end of Woodlawn Beach in Buffalo, New York.

Jacket: Dark Blue, Brand: Carhartt; size: small
Sweater: Blue, Sweatshirt with cut off sleeves
Blue, Pullover sweater; brand: Mountain Expedition

Case reference: 2016045557.CaseDesc: In January 2015, Warner Huckerby was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2019068219.CaseDesc: On November 17, 2019, Marshal Iwaasa was last seen by his family in Lethbridge, Alberta. During this time, Marshal had told his family that he was returning to Calgary, Alberta. On November 23, his burnt vehicle was recovered at the end of Phelix Creek Forest Service Road, in a remote area near the Birkenhead Lake Provincial Park in British Columbia.

Case reference: 2012020142.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2008, Shannon Alexander, 17 and Maisy Odjick, 16, were reported missing from the First Nation community of Kitigan Zibi in Quebec. This community is located near the town of Maniwaki. On September 5, 2008, the two girls went to the Maniwaki arena, where several young people were present. Maisy then went to spend the night at Shannon’s house. Shannon’s father was the last person to have seen his daughter on September 6, 2008. In 2015 an age progression was done for both Maisy and Shannon.

Pierce: Mouth, 2 loops on the lower lip

Case reference: 2014003280.CaseDesc: On July 7, 1998, Peter Dekoning was reported missing after failing to return home from making his restaurant deliveries. He was last seen at Jackfish Lake near Two Hills where he was believed to have stayed for several days. His vehicle was located near the North Saskatchewan river with the keys missing. There was no sign of foul play. A search of land and water was unsuccessful.

Pants: Dark Blue, Black, pants were either dark blue or black
Scar: Jaw, long white scar down right side of chin

Case reference: 2006024299.CaseDesc: Harold Cottrell was last seen on September 28, 1984, in a boat on Northwind Lake in Northern Ontario. It is believed that the aluminium boat he was travelling in with some companions was overloaded. The vessel began to submerge.  Despite extensive search efforts, Harold could not be located and is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2013000037.CaseDesc: On November 29, 2001, Henry Murillo Asprilla was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. On that day, he had a meeting with lawyers, which he attended with his ex-wife. After the meeting he drove his ex-wife home. Henry has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005110.CaseDesc: On June 3, 2008, at approximately 9:25 p.m., Jaquelyn Latto was seen for the last time as she left the Juliette Place Shelter in Toronto, Ontario. Jaquelyn had told the staff at the shelter that she was going out with her brother.

Case reference: 2014004549.CaseDesc: Anthony Wennekers was seen for the last time in July 2003, downtown Calgary, Alberta.  Anthony suffers from a mental disability and was leading a high risk lifestyle at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014001445.CaseDesc: On July 13, 1992, Howard Scott was last seen in Calgary, Alberta. Howard was travelling in his red 1985 Ford LTD Station Wagon from Calgary and was destined to return to Richmond, British Columbia. On August 15, 1992, Howard’s abandoned vehicle was located in a heavily wooded logging road near Moyie, British Columbia.  Howard has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001028.CaseDesc: The body of this middle aged man was found in the Fraser River near Quesnel, British Columbia on May 20, 1968. He was well dressed and had custom orthotic supports in his shoes. He would have been born around 1920, had grey hair and likely had full dentures.

Other: Case, Leather case with nail clippers
Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Pen Knife, Pen Knife
Leather, Black, Small key case with 15 keys
Shoes: Leather, Black, Pointed dress shoe with Dr.Scholl's arch support insole
Wallet: Brown, Light brown leather wallet with dark brown stitching

Case reference: 2013000115.CaseDesc: Gaby Luonga Kombe was last seen on August 23, 1999, in Montreal, Quebec. Gaby had to go to Pie-IX metro station to meet a friend. Later in the evening, he called his son to tell him he was heading home. Gaby has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014004703.CaseDesc: On August 13, 1995, Marie-Josée Boisjoli left her home in Laval, Quebec, mentioning that she was going to an appointment. The following day, Marie-Josée's vehicle and personal belongings were found at the family cottage, located in the Gélinas Lake area in Mont-Tremblant, Quebec. Marie-Josée has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2006013899.CaseDesc: Robert Heintz went missing from Kearns, Ontario on the morning of November 30, 1982.  Robert went into the bush behind Larder Lake Public School with some friends and became separated from them.  He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2012020159.CaseDesc: In July 2004, the remains of an unidentified man were found on the shore of the Fraser River in Richmond, British Columbia. The man had good dental work and had a gold tooth in his left lower jaw. It is estimated that he may have died in 2003 or early 2004.

Case reference: 2014005571.CaseDesc: On March 18, 2011, Isabelle Roy-Roland left the Hotel Dieu Hospital of Lévis, in Levis, Quebec after receiving permission to leave the grounds. Isabelle was never seen again.

Coat: Brown, 3/4 length coat with fur on the hood

Case reference: 2014003404.CaseDesc: Armand Comtois was reported missing on May 2, 1985. At the time of his disappearance he was living in Saint-Hyacinthe, Quebec. He was seen by a family member on March 9, 1985 but he has not been seen or heard from since this date. He also used the name of "Simon".

Teeth: Dental appliance, partial composed of 4 upper teeth.

Case reference: 2014004454.CaseDesc: In Mid December 1991, Richard (Rick) Dale Beaudoin went missing after setting out in a canoe from Vancouver, British Columbia destined for Powell River on Sunshine Coast BC Canada. Rick was travelling solo in a 14' red/orange Frontiersman fiberglass freight canoe with wooden seats and a distinct square stern. The last contact with him was on December 29th when he phoned relatives from a Pender Harbour payphone. Rick was known to be evangelical about the Christian religion, often preaching to people he met in his travels. Rick had a damaged and blackened left eye tooth.

Teeth: Left canine tooth (eye tooth) is damaged and darkened/blackened in appearance.
Jacket: Light Blue, Ski jacket with dark blue patches
Pants: Other, Burgundy color rain pants with blue side leg zippers on each leg
